# Vendored Pyodide package artifact

`micropip-0.11.1-py3-none-any.whl` is the exact package referenced by `pyodide@314.0.7` in `pyodide-lock.json`.

- Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v314.0.7/full/micropip-0.11.1-py3-none-any.whl`
- SHA-256: `e2d52886594fd4cd0d0847110a1c34ae0134d3a970eb4496d3b5eb31ee2d8af6`
- Purpose: copied beside the locally hosted Pyodide core so `loadPackage("micropip")` performs no runtime CDN request.
